title: How Do Habits Form?
paragraphs: A habit is something we do again and again. We often do it without thinking. For example, we brush our teeth every morning.
A habit has three parts. First, there is a sign. Then we do the action. After that, we get something good.
For example, you see your phone. You open it. You see a new message. You feel good. Next time, you open it again.
New habits take time. Do a small thing every day at the same time. After some weeks, it is easy.
